description: Driver commands for tools/engineer_eval.py, seeded from the rows of docs/engineer-command-matrix.md that the synthetic states can express. 'matrix' states start from the command matrix seed (lap 8/20, P3, mediums, fuel -0.4 laps, battery 62 percent); 'scenario' states replay a tools/scenarios.py race through the real packet parser. Fact paths read state.* (the state the command is asked in), tool.<name>.* (the deterministic tool on that state) or after.* (the state once answered). 'scripted' is the reply the offline provider gives, with {path|filter} placeholders filled from those facts; live runs ignore it. Cases whose command is answered locally never reach a provider.

not_seeded.Pre-race agreement: needs an open pre-race proposal, which neither synthetic state carries
not_seeded.Setup: needs saved setups and a setup packet history
not_seeded.History: needs saved practice runs from earlier sessions
not_seeded.Session best: needs a recorded lap history with validity bits
not_seeded.Incomplete history: needs a recorded lap history with gaps
not_seeded.Result not received: needs a final classification packet to contrast with
not_seeded.Notes: needs recorded laps in the current timeline for the note to attach to
not_seeded.Red flag: a known tyre inventory needs a tyre-set packet; the unknown-inventory case covers the suspension call itself
not_seeded.Red flag, worn same compound: telling a fresh medium set from the fitted one needs a tyre-set packet; the unknown-inventory case runs on worn mediums

cases.utterance: Give me the full pit strategy and its best alternative.

scripted.reply: A second compound is mandatory: box lap {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.box_laps.0} for {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.compounds.-1|plural}. The alternative is lap {tool.get_pit_strategy.plans.1.box_laps.0} for {tool.get_pit_strategy.plans.1.compounds.-1|plural}. Confidence is {tool.get_pit_strategy.confidence}, so treat it as provisional.

cases.utterance: Mark, should I box now or stay out and defend?

scripted.reply: Stay out for now and defend; box lap {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.box_laps.0} for {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.compounds.-1|plural}, because a second compound is still owed.

cases.utterance: Mark, can I hold Antonelli off if I stay out to the end?

scripted.reply: No, not to the end: a second compound is still owed, so box lap {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.box_laps.0} for {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.compounds.-1|plural}. Antonelli is {tool.get_pit_strategy.defence.gap_s} seconds behind; protect the exits until then.

cases.utterance: Mark, what is my tire situation and how many laps are left?

scripted.reply: {state.tyre.compound|plural|capital} are {state.tyre.age_laps} laps old at up to {state.tyre.wear|max|int} percent wear, with {tool.get_pit_strategy.laps_remaining} laps left. A second compound is still owed: box lap {tool.get_pit_strategy.recommended.box_laps.0}.

cases.utterance: Box lap 12 for hards.
Clear my strategy override.
What tyres am I on?
Give me tyre temperatures in Fahrenheit.
Do I need to save fuel, and what pace will that cost?

scripted.reply: Yes, we are {state.fuel_laps_delta|abs} laps short, so lift and coast. Over the {tool.get_pace_mode_options.laps_remaining} laps left that is an estimated {tool.get_pace_mode_options.estimated_cost_s_per_lap} seconds a lap, a planning figure, not a measured loss.

cases.utterance: Battery.
Active aero.
With low battery, can I use DRS?

scripted.reply: Yes, DRS is yours when you are eligible; a {state.ers_pct} percent battery does not switch off the flap, it only limits deployment.

cases.utterance: Can I attack the car ahead next lap?

scripted.reply: Not yet: the gap is {tool.get_attack_plan.gap_s|abs} seconds and Overtake Mode is not available now, so a close gap today does not promise it next lap. Battery is {state.ers_pct} percent; build the run out of the last corner.

cases.utterance: How should I defend against the car behind?

scripted.reply: {tool.get_defence_plan.driver} is {tool.get_defence_plan.gap_s} seconds behind. Pick one defensive line into the braking zone and protect your exit; no weaving.

cases.utterance: Weather forecast.
What flags or penalties do I need to react to?

scripted.reply: Green flag, nothing from race control. You carry a {state.penalties_s} second penalty and {state.corner_cutting_warnings} track-limit warnings, with nothing unserved.
